commercialPurpose: Give editorial sites a category archive page that prioritizes scanning many posts while keeping sidebar discovery visible.
purposeLayer: The archive helps users browse a topic through repeated horizontal article summaries.
anatomyLayer: Tinted category banner, repeated list rows with left thumbnail and right text, post meta/category chip, excerpt, older-post pagination, and persistent sidebar widgets.
hierarchyLayer: Category banner first, list thumbnails/titles second, sidebar widgets third, pagination last.
gridRhythmLayer: Two-column archive frame: wide vertical list lane plus narrow widget sidebar.
densityLimitLayer: Use 6-12 visible rows, one thumbnail per row, 1-2 metadata lines, 3-8 sidebar widgets, and pagination.
originalityLayer: Learn category archive scanning; transform banner treatment, row density, thumbnail ratios, and sidebar purpose.
usageRuleLayer: Use for CMS categories, resource indexes, news archives, portfolio filters, and content-heavy template packs.
layoutGesture: category banner above thumbnail-list archive with sidebar rail
sectionSilhouette: thin tinted topic banner over long left list and right widget column
compositionTension: many compact article rows balanced by a persistent trust/discovery sidebar
focalPath: category label to first list row to repeated rows to sidebar discovery
negativeSpaceShape: horizontal row gaps inside a vertical archive corridor
depthLayering: flat rows with small media badges and boxed sidebar widgets
moduleScaleVariation: small repeated thumbnails with compact text summaries
breakoutBehavior: category banner spans wider than list content
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact category photos, gold tint overlay, row spacing, media icons, or sidebar order.

hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint 002 is visually inspected learning evidence; keep incoming until exact hyper-accuracy review and dedupe rationale pass.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy the exact Pallas editorial visuals, startup hero background, coral/teal color identity, photo assets, sidebar widget order, or footer treatment.
